content: {"episode_id":"ep-05061","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 based on the documented clinical indication for prolonged cardiac event monitoring. The patient has recurrent palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent lightheadedness that are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings, with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, supraventricular tachycardia, and sick sinus syndrome. The clinical indication note states that prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances."}
